question: The graph of the linear function \(y=kx+b\) passes through points \((1,3)\) and \((3,7)\). Find the \(y\)-coordinate of its intersection with the \(y\)-axis.
solution: \(k=(7-3)/(3-1)=2\). Then \(3=2\times1+b\) gives \(b=1\), so the intersection with the \(y\)-axis is \((0,1)\).
